problems.problem: The declared signature event is a long floor shadow whose outline narrows and curves into the Coca-Cola contour profile ('影子先到,曲线随后'). In the poster the cast shade below the base (visible from y≈1050 to y≈1300) is a faint amorphous vertical smudge with no contour curvature and almost no value contrast against the #B9B4AC-family floor, so the titular 'shadow keeps the appointment' reads as a reflection artifact, not a shaped arriving guest.
problems.root_cause: background.prompt describes the contour-tapering shade only verbally; the generated floor rendered a generic soft smear at too low opacity to carry the silhouette curve.
problems.repair_strategy: Regenerate the empty set with a prompt that states the floor shade as a clearly darker, gently S-curved tapering form extending from center base toward the foreground, still diffuse and equipment-free, so the shadow event becomes legible at poster distance.

problems.problem: The unmodified source photograph is an even, low-contrast, front/above lit cutout on a light-grey backdrop. The poster places it inside a near-charcoal upper backdrop; the bright neck glass and white script now sit against a dark wall while the base sits on a much lighter floor pool, so the product looks lit for a different room than the set. The strong horizontal floor/wall tonal break at y≈800 behind the bottle also cuts the silhouette at label height.
problems.root_cause: background.prompt asked for 'dusk-grey... dimmer grey backdrop' producing a dark wall, conflicting with the observed soft bright studio illumination of the source asset.
problems.repair_strategy: Regenerate with a mid-grey seamless cyc whose value stays close to the source backdrop, brightest around the product column, gradient only gentle, so the cutout's own lighting remains believable.

problems.problem: integration_plan cast values (opacity 0.28, blur 30) plus shadow.opacity 0.35 produce a floor shade so faint that the contact cue in the enlarged crop [543,905,883,1155] is a barely-there darkening under the glass base; contact exists (base_y 1045 meets the shade with no gap), but the grounding reads tentative rather than settled, and the 'long shadow' half of the concept carries almost no ink.
problems.root_cause: Cast opacity/blur tuned for whisper-soft dusk instead of a legible diffuse elongation.
problems.repair_strategy: Raise integration_plan.cast_opacity toward its 0.3 ceiling, tighten cast_blur slightly and raise shadow.opacity so the contact and the elongated shade read as one continuous event; keep offset_y at 0 because contact is correctly aligned.

problems.problem: The vertical serif title (white, x≈86-188, y≈288-724) holds the left column well, but the subtitle at size 28 (y≈886-912) and the latin logo at size 36 (y≈1037-1064) are visually thin against the 110pt title and the 650px-tall bottle; from viewing distance the left column collapses to one stroke of white and two grey whispers, leaving the lower-left quadrant under-anchored versus the references' confident type blocks.
problems.root_cause: Subtitle/logo sizes and tracking set for page reading, not poster distance; no size relationship bridges title to logo.
problems.repair_strategy: Increase subtitle size and logo size modestly and add tracking to the logo so the left column reads as three deliberate steps; keep exact copy, left alignment and the reserved white band.

problems.problem: References 3-5 each commit to one dominant crafted gesture (sculpted liquid lines, staged color field, splash crown). This poster's single gesture - the contour shadow - is present only as a vague smudge, so against those benchmarks the execution reads competent-but-unfinished: clean cutout, safe asymmetry, unresolved hero event.
problems.root_cause: Concept ambition exceeds the rendered scene's contrast budget.
problems.repair_strategy: Spend the poster's contrast on the shadow form (problem 1) and calm the backdrop (problem 2) so one crafted gesture dominates, matching reference-level resolve without changing genre or palette.

changes.value: Mid-grey seamless studio cyclorama, value close to a light-grey product backdrop, gentle vertical gradient darkest only at the top corners, floor slightly lighter than the wall with no hard horizon line, one clearly visible diffuse floor shade in a darker grey stretching from the center base toward the foreground, its outline tapering and bending in a soft S-curve like an elongated bottle contour, soft diffuse frontal overhead illumination, empty set, no visible equipment

logo_correct.evidence: Lower-left latin lockup reads 'Coca-Cola' in the approved GOTHIC.TTF style, and the bottle's red band carries the white script plus 'ORIGINAL TASTE' exactly as in the source asset.

shape_preserved.evidence: Rendered bbox [623,395,803,1045] keeps the symmetric contour silhouette, red crown cap and full label band identical to the original crop; no warp or clipping at canvas edges.

grounding_correct.evidence: Enlarged contact crop [543,905,883,1155] shows the glass base meeting a soft dark contact shade at base_y 1045 with no daylight gap; shadow offset_y 0 is correct, though faint (flagged as a strength problem, not absence).

edges_clean.evidence: Cutout edges against the grey cyc are smooth with no halo fringe except a negligible bright rim at the glass foot that reads as base highlight; no duplicate bottles or invented labels anywhere.

lighting_consistent.evidence: Source asset is evenly front/above lit on light grey; the poster's near-charcoal upper wall and bright floor pool contradict that illumination, making the pasted cutout's brightness read as a different studio.

text_uncropped.evidence: Title bbox [86,288,188,724], subtitle [86,886,337,912], logo [86,1037,304,1064] all sit fully inside the 1080x1440 canvas with comfortable margins.

text_collision_free.evidence: geometry.text_product_overlap is false for title, subtitle and logo; no layer intersects the product bbox on both axes.

fonts_present.evidence: simsun.ttc renders the CJK title/subtitle and GOTHIC.TTF renders the latin logo; both are in the installed approved list and glyph coverage is visibly complete.

brand_spelling_correct.evidence: 'Coca-Cola' spelled correctly in both the logo layer and the on-bottle band; no stray brand text generated.

copy_concept_specific.evidence: '一影赴约' and '影子先到,曲线随后' name this poster's exact shadow-arrival mechanism and contour curve; they are not interchangeable slogans.

visual_memory_visible.evidence: The memorable relationship (shadow arriving first with a contour-curved outline) is only a faint straight smudge in the render, so the intended visual event is not actually identifiable at poster distance.

commercial_gate.basis: visual-model evidence plus deterministic geometry; not independent human commercial certification
